# player <home|away> <nr> <x> <y> <standing|prone> <active|used>
# occ <hex, one byte per cell, row-major over W=26 by H=15>
# tz <side 0=home 1=away> <hex, one byte per cell>
# rowprefix <side> <decimal, H*(W+1) entries, comma separated>
# unact <side> <f32 bits>
# ball <x> <y> <inplay> <moving>   (absent when there is no ball)
# blitz <home_used> <away_used>
# threatreach|threatmark|lane|support <side> <hex, 8 chars of f32 bits per cell>
# threatstr <side> <hex, one signed byte per cell>
